thread:
Maya Lopez: Heads-up: launching a 9-week pilot for two new PTO conveniences starting June 1. Please skim and share with your managers. Key bits: 
1) Emergency PTO Advance (up to 3 days) 3-approval by manager, reconciled on next payroll. Retro requests allowed within 7 business days.
2) Domestic Short-Trip Declaration 3-quick self-declare form for same-country trips under 72 hours; removes full travel preapproval for eligible employees.
Full handbook page: https://redwood.company/hr/quick-pto-pilot (faq + form links). :sparkles:

Jon Park: Quick Q 3 does this affect PTO accrual or leave balances immediately?

Maya Lopez: Its an advance against future accruals, not a change to accrual policy. Payroll will offset in the following pay cycle if accruals haven't covered the advance. Not taxable income.

Evan Brooks: Are contractors included? What about part-timers?

Maya Lopez: Eligibility: full-time employees and contractors on >6mo engagements. Part-time/hourly on a case-by-case basisemail people-ops for exceptions.

Jon Park: For Short-Trip Declaration, what counts as "same-country" for global employees on cross-entity travel (e.g., UK->IE)?

Maya Lopez: Good catch. Short-Trip Declaration is limited to travel within the same legal entity/country payroll. Cross-entity or international trips still need the standard travel preapproval. If unsure, choose the full approval.

People Ops Bot: New handbook entry published: /handbook/people-ops/quick-pto-pilot.md. Manager checklist and LMS training link added.

Evan Brooks: If emergency already happened, what's the retro workflow?

Maya Lopez: Submit the advance form, mark the notes with RETRO-ADVANCE, manager signs off. Must be submitted within 7 business days. Payroll will handle reconciliation on next cycle.

Payroll Team: Noted 3 please ensure managers include the pay period in the form so we can match reconciliations.

Maya Lopez: We'll run a short survey halfway through pilot and share metrics (approval time, number of advances, retro rate). Pilot dates: June 1 3 July 28. DM questions or ping people-ops. Thanks! :pray:
